title: Snow Blower Cover 120 × 82 × 60 cm – Keeps Debris Out
seo_description: Snow blower cover in dimensions 120 × 82 × 60 cm, black/silver. Keeps leaves, dust and debris off the machine between uses.
descriptionHtml:
The debris that collects while it sits idle

Between snowfalls the snow blower stands bare in the driveway or garage – leaves, conifer needles and dust settle on the housing and work their way into the gaps around the engine, month after month, without you doing anything about it.

A cover in the right size – 120 × 82 × 60 cm

The black/silver cover goes over the snow blower between uses and covers the housing in height, width and length. The dimensions 120 × 82 × 60 cm are made for the snow blower, not a generic tarp.

Features

  • Debris lands on the cover, not on the snow blower – a full-coverage cover goes directly over the whole machine.
  • Fits snow blowers up to 120 × 82 × 60 cm – the cover's length, width and height.
  • Protects the sides too, not just the top – the cover's height and width dimensions cover the snow blower all around.
  • Discreet in the garage – black with silver accents instead of a brightly colored tarp.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
